text:
Pranav: Heads-up — I sketched a microbilling visibility idea for token-level + cache savings attribution. Want to get product + billing input before I spike a prototype.

Ela: Nice. Is this for the console only or API too? We need per-route breakdowns for quota enforcement.

Pranav: Console + API. Two parts: 1) per-invocation estimated charge (tokens * unit-rate) after cache offsets; 2) a per-period reconciliation view showing actual charged vs estimated (to handle fallback/rollouts).

Mala: Will the per-invocation estimate include KV/prefix cache credits? Eg cached KV hits shouldn’t count against customer tokens.

Pranav: Yes — proposal is: runtime emits a telemetry line per request like: `cost_event: {route, model, tokens_used, cache_hits, cache_saved_tokens, backend_variant}`. Then aggregation layer computes `net_tokens = tokens_used - cache_saved_tokens` and multiplies by per-unit price.

Jess: Sounds good. A couple concerns: accuracy when we use fallbacks (model downgrade), and when batching merges multiple requests. How do we split costs in a batch?

Pranav: For batching we propose proportional split by tokens_used_prebatching. If any request got cached prefix, that request’s saved tokens are subtracted first. For fallback, the runtime includes `served_model` field so reconciliation can attribute the final model.

Ela: API quota enforcement needs to act on the estimated net_tokens in real-time. Any risk of customers being rate-limited incorrectly due to later reconciliation adjustments?

Mala: We'll surface a conservative estimate in quota checks (round up) and expose a daily reconciliation delta in the console. If delta > 5% we flag and notify billing team.

Jess: UI asks: want to show both "gross tokens", "cache savings", and "net tokens" columns. Also provide a toggle to view costs using committed discounts/tiers. UX team ok with that?

Pranav: Yup. Also adding a small tooltip explaining reconciliation window: `Charges are estimated at request time and reconciled within 24h when batching/fallbacks are finalized.` Keep text terse.

billing-bot: [automated] Note: chargeback impacts should be included in next week's billing export schema v3. Please open a PR to ops/billing repo with the schema change.

Ela: Next step — @Mala or @Jess can you mock the console columns? I'll draft the telemetry schema and a lightweight consumer lambda to compute per-route daily aggregates.

Mala: On it. I'll drop a Figma link and a quick mock by EOD. :thumbsup:

Jess: I'll coordinate with UX. Also will add a small per-route alert in console when reconciliation delta > 5%.

Pranav: Thanks. I'll create an RFC with schema + runtime emittance points. For the filename/internal PR, let's use `microbilling_v1`.

Mala: One more ask: let's include model quantization tag (e.g., q4_0, int8) in telemetry so we can expose per-model unit economics.

Pranav: Good call. Adding `model_variant` and `quant_tag` fields.

Ela: OK closing this thread — please ping here when mocks/RFC PRs exist.

Pranav: Will do.
